Danish police averted an attempt by Russian intelligence services to assassinate a US-Ukrainian rapper in September ahead of a planned performance in Denmark, a senior Danish official said on Friday.
Police thwarted the alleged plot when they arrested three men with links to the Danish criminal underworld shortly before the rapper Kyivstoner was due to give a concert on September 25, which was then cancelled, officials said.
“It is our clear assessment that the assassination attempt was planned by the Russian intelligence services,” Rasmus Kieffer-Kristensen, head of Denmark’s national security and intelligence service, PET, told a press conference.

Leaders from the United Kingdom and European Union have reached what’s been hailed as a “win-win” deal, in a summit held as British Prime Minister Andy Burnham pushes for a closer relationship with the bloc a decade after the Brexit vote.
A new package of agreements to create new opportunities for young people to live, study and travel on the continent, link emissions trading, and remove trade barriers on food products has been agreed, a UK government spokesperson told CNN on Friday.
Burnham welcomed the “landmark” deal, saying it draws a line “on a decade of drift and division by reconnecting with old friends.”
“We’re 10 years on from Brexit, but I think we can all confidently say this is a good day for Britain, and this is a good day for Europe. The agreement that we’ve reached together is a win-win,” he said at a news conference following the Brussels summit.

Tens of thousands of young people are slated to fill Europe’s streets on Friday – in an organized international youth-led day of action across more than 25 nations.
Student groups in the UK, France, Spain, Italy and beyond will walk out over the sky-rocketing cost of living, rising tuition fees, underfunded education systems and what they cast as leaders’ complicity in Israel’s war in Gaza.
Other grievances that have prompted Gen-Z protests this fall include high unemployment, the climate crisis and fears governments are failing to future-proof against unregulated artificial intelligence.
